title: Re:Disc
description: Re:Disc adds various music discs to naturally generate in existing vanilla chests from the popular anime Re:Zero.
body:
# Re:Disc #

## Metia ##
This is an item crafted from the recipe shown in the *Gallery*, which once crafted *(you can only carry one at a time)* allows you to remotely play music from anywhere in a playlist as long as you put the disc on the phone.

**PUTTING THE DISC INTO THE PHONE WILL NOT CONSUME THE DISC**

## Current Discs (8) ## 
Suzuki - **Recollect** (S4 Intro)

Suehiro - **Requiem of Silence** (S1 E15)

Maeshima - **Long Shot** (S2 Opening 2)

Suzuki - **redo** (S1 Opening 1)

MYTH & ROID - **Ender Ember** (S4 Ending)

Takahashi - **Stay Alive** (S1 Ending 2 / S4 E11)

MYTH & ROID - **Paradisus-Paradoxum** (S1 Opening 2)

MYTH & ROID - **STRAIGHT BET** (S1 E7 / S2 E14)

MYTH & ROID - **Styx Helix** (S1 Ending 1)


## Obtainment ## 
**Recollect** - Desert Pyramid (7.5%)

**Requiem of Silence** - Igloo (100%)

**Long Shot** - Jungle Temple (17.5%)

**redo** - Woodland Mansion (15%)

**Ender Ember** - Bastion Treasure Chest (100%)

**Stay Alive** - End City Chest (2.5%)

**Paradisus-Paradoxum** - Buried Treasure (25%) / Shipwreck Treasure (5%)

**STRAIGHT BET** - Ruined Portal (20%)

**Styx Helix** - Ancient City Ice Box (100%)


_Note: These songs are in no way owned by me and are properly credited to the original author. I simply made this mod to add Peak:Zero music into minecraft. Thanks for installing and playing my mod <3_
